entities.name: Sami
entities.description: A human artificer, wildcat captain and engineer of the Seriema from the Sothera System.

entities.name: Tannuk
entities.description: A Kav and Sami's best friend and crewmate.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: Sami's pet cat, who weftwalked off the ship.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Planeswalker who contracted Sami and Tannuk to retrieve the Endstone.

entities.name: Endstone
entities.description: A dark egg-shaped rock with causality-influencing powers.

entities.name: Alpharael
entities.description: A Monoist rescued by Sami and Tannuk, suspected to be a chosen one of the Endstone.

entities.name: Haliya
entities.description: A Summist soldier who snuck aboard the Seriema to take the stone and later decided it must not fall into Summist hands.

entities.name: Sunstar Free Company
entities.description: Summist group that followed Alpharael and massacred Taro-duend.

entities.name: Monoists
entities.description: Faction that converged on Infinite Guideline Station for the stone.

entities.name: Infinite Guideline Station
entities.description: Station in the Sothera system where the Endstone wanted to go.

entities.name: Taro-duend
entities.description: Kav colony massacred by the Summists.

entities.name: Kavaron
entities.description: World orbited by a debris field where Sami worked.

entities.name: Wurmwall
entities.description: Region where the crew drifted after the station battle.

entities.name: Wurm Speaker
entities.description: Ship on which Sami came to the Sothera system, crashed in a catastrophic event.

entities.name: Vaar android
entities.description: Android that stepped from a hole in space to reclaim the Endstone.

events.summary: The Wurm Speaker suffers a catastrophic event at the Wurmwall; most of the crew die and Tannuk helps Sami escape.
events.quote: After a catastrophic event, most of the crew were killed.
Sami later bought a ship of their own, called the Seriema .

events.summary: Mirri weftwalks off the ship and Sami's search costs them most of their crew, leaving Tannuk.
Tezzeret contracts Sami and Tannuk to retrieve the Endstone from Sigma's Reach, where they find the colony vacant and the rock.
events.quote: they found the colony mysteriously vacant

events.summary: Sami and Tannuk save Alpharael after his ship crashes; Summists pursue, Haliya tries to steal the stone, and Sami and Tannuk flee Kavaron.
events.quote: allowing Sami and Tannuk to access the ship's controls and flee Kavaron

events.summary: The Summists massacre the civilians of Taro-duend to purge the Endstone's influence.
events.quote: the Summists massacred the innocent civilians in Taro-duend

events.summary: The crew takes the Endstone to Infinite Guideline Station, uses the station to warp enemies into the Wurmwall, and Sami recovers Mirri.
events.quote: they managed to use the station to warp them out into the Wurmwall

events.summary: A Vaar android steps from a hole in space and reclaims the Endstone.
events.quote: a Vaar android stepped out to reclaim the Endstone

relations.quote: They are the best friend of Tannuk
the captain and engineer of the Seriema
Sami and Tannuk were contracted by Tezzeret

relations.note: Followed and suspected him to be a chosen one.
relations.quote: suspected him to be one of its chosen
